title: Harden Launch preflight scope guardrails
summary: Add explicit active/skipped target modeling for Launch backend preflight so only active workflow payloads contribute to status, rows, and readiness summaries.
reason: The immediate inactive CSV blocker was fixed, but future Launch workflows still needed a reusable guardrail that makes target applicability visible and prevents inactive blocked payloads from poisoning active Pipeline readiness.
behavior_before: Launch preflight request filtering was present for empty CSV state, but skipped-target evidence and status-included payload filtering were not first-class contracts.
behavior_after: Launch preflight builds candidate, active, skipped, and status-included sets; summaries show active targets and skipped inactive targets; overall status and rows ignore explicitly inactive payloads.
